name: Haas UMC TCPC
description: Millimetre Haas mill dialect for indexed 3+2 and continuous five-axis with TCPC (G234). Percent-delimited program O00001, sequence numbers, incremental IJK arcs and helices, dwell P in milliseconds. A axis with inverse-time feed (G93, cancelled by G94) when the angle changes. G254 is the dynamic work offset and G255 cancels it. Indexed 3+2 uses G254. A continuous toolpath cancels G254 with G255, retracts, zeros the rotaries, then commands G234 H with the tool number. XYZ is the part-frame tool tip. A rapid that changes a rotary is G1 under G93 at 5000 mm/min. G49 cancels G234 and G43 restores the length offset. The kinematics file must match the machine. This output has not been proven on a machine.
references: G254/G255: B and C positioning only; invoke after rotary motion; X and Y in one block then Z; cancel with G255 before any rotary motion; G53 not affected. https://www.haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G254.html
G53 machine-coordinate move, not affected by G254: https://www.haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G53.html

G234 Tool Center Point Control: same block as H, cancels G43; rotaries at 0; XYZ is the tool tip; no rapid with a rotary; G49 cancels it. https://www.haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G234.html
